## History

Nora is an imaginary rock person created by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), who considers her his favorite of all his fictional shoreline companions. Along with the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md) and the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md) of the cave, Nora featured in Paul's magical childhood adventures about sailing into moonglades and visiting the sunset land. However, as [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) grows older during a summer in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), he begins to lose these imaginative shoreline visions.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P45](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0045), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P46](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0046), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P3](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0003), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P6](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0006), +41 more_
